purpose: Finite retrospective mechanism diagnostics, not a new formal Monte Carlo comparison.
user_authorization: User accepted continuing the baseline implementation investigation on 2026-10-24.
selection: Evenly spaced fixed IDs 0,64,...,960; no error, activity or completion filtering.
threshold_policy: Keep current frozen threshold per method; no fitting.
interpretation: Small sample for per-scene numerical effects; insufficient to establish rare-event AER improvement. Evaluation scenes were already viewed.
noise: Same observation-estimated noise and existing Gamma prior; no true noise or activity count in inference.
stop_policy: Stop after fixed cases; no automatic budget or sample expansion. Failures remain recorded.

sources.offgrid: Wei 2022, arXiv:2101.05629v1, Sec. III-B Eqs.17-24, Sec.IV Algorithm1.
sources.somp: Tropp-Gilbert-Strauss, Algorithm3.1. 64/128 atom caps are project diagnostic settings.
